user.title: CentoAccess
user.description: Choose a location. The Home Assistant location is selected by default. The commune must use CentoAccess.

postal_commune.title: Search by postal code
postal_commune.description: Enter the first 2 to 5 digits of a postal code, then choose a commune on the next screen.

cento_select.title: Choose a CentoAccess application
cento_select.description: Several CentoAccess applications match this commune.

error.invalid_location: No reliable French commune match was found.
error.ambiguous_location: Several communes match. Enter a more precise address.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the geographic or CentoAccess service.
error.not_centoaccess: This commune does not use CentoAccess, so this integration cannot be set up for it.

abort.already_configured: This CentoAccess commune is already configured.
abort.invalid_location: The selected commune or CentoAccess application is no longer available.
